summary: John's 4th-great-grand-aunt (sister of Mary Connole); mother of Dr. Thomas J. Dailey.
bio:
Honora 'Nora' Connole was born in Plymouth Township in 1855 (per her son's biography; FamilySearch: Jun 1856) and died 3 Oct 1910. She married William Dailey (b. Schuylkill Co. 1851). Her 1855 Plymouth birth is the main evidence that the Connoles reached Plymouth well before Mary's obituary's '1865'.

FamilySearch gives her husband as William J. Dailey (b. Minersville 17 Feb 1854, d. Wilkes-Barre 18 Jan 1931, son of Michael Dailey and Elizabeth Keating) and lists eleven children, among them Elizabeth A. (1877-1958), Honora (1878-1961), Anna Hilary (1880-1951), Michael (1882-1902), Dr. Thomas Joseph (1884-1934), Gertrude F. (1890-1929), Loretta Alberta (1891-1967), Theressa Rosalind (1893-1985) and Margaret (1895-1987) ([R4-S1], [R4-S2]).
sources: Harvey & Smith vol. VI, T. J. Dailey sketch p.~422: https://archive.org/details/historyofwilkesb06harv

Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
